summary: Almondz Global Securities reported a 140% YoY rise in consolidated profit to ₹9.13 crore. The infra segment secured ₹154 crore in new orders, while ethanol revenue surged 55.7%.

headline: Aether Industries signs supply pact with Baker Petrolite
summary: Aether Industries has formed a supply agreement with Baker Petrolite LLC to manufacture Drag Reducing Agents at India's first such facility in Panoli, Gujarat.

headline: Maharashtra forest dept halts Adani Green's Tarali hydro project
summary: Maharashtra's Forest Department has issued a work halt notice for Adani Green Energy's Tarali Hydropower Project, signalling a regulatory intervention in the project's construction activities.

headline: Union Bank of India to host roadshow in Singapore
summary: Union Bank of India will conduct non-deal roadshows in Singapore on November 19 and 20, 2026. The meetings are one-to-one and in-person, with no unpublished price-sensitive information shared.

headline: Lords Mark Industries Q2FY27 results
summary: Lords Mark Industries reported a massive turnaround in Q2FY27 with standalone revenue jumping to ₹3,749.44 crore and net profit of ₹473.98 crore against a prior year loss.

headline: Liotech Q2FY27: EBITDA margin hits 18.46%
summary: Liotech Industries reported H1FY27 revenue of ₹33.64 crore and EBITDA margin of 18.46%. Management targets 14-15% margins post-capex expansion.

headline: Embassy Developments launches ₹1,400 cr luxury project
summary: Embassy Developments unveiled Embassy ONE Residences, a 59-unit ultra-luxury project in Bengaluru with a GDV of ~₹1,400 crore, bringing its FY27 cumulative GDV to ~₹9,000 crore.

headline: BSE shares flag large trade at ₹4001.50 per share
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 117,229 BSE shares changing hands at ₹4001.50, with a combined value of ₹46.91 crore on the NSE platform.

headline: Persistent Systems shares flag large-trade signal on BSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 1,00,360 shares of Persistent Systems on BSE at ₹6019.00, with a combined value of ₹60.41 crore.

headline: Mappls integrates with Arattai for seamless navigation
summary: C.E. Info Systems Ltd announced the integration of its Mappls app with Zoho's Arattai messaging platform, enabling users to navigate directly to locations shared in chats.

headline: TTK Prestige holds physical investor meet
summary: TTK Prestige Limited conducted a physical meeting with Avendus Spark on November 17, 2026, in compliance with SEBI LODR regulations.

headline: Balkrishna Industries gets GST order for ₹3.94 lakh
summary: Balkrishna Industries received a GST adjudication order for ₹3.94 lakh interest for FY21-FY23. The company states no financial impact and plans to appeal.

headline: BPCL to expand Mumbai SAF plant capacity
summary: Bharat Petroleum plans to boost Mumbai Sustainable Aviation Fuel plant capacity to 61,000 tons per year by 2028. A 40,000-ton green jet fuel unit is slated for December launch.

headline: Shadowfax board approves 2.5% ESOP pool hike
summary: Shadowfax Technologies board approved increasing its ESOP pool by 1.47 crore options, representing 2.5% of paid-up capital, to support growth and talent retention.

headline: SEBI mulls linking margin purchase limits to free float
summary: SEBI is considering tightening rules for leveraged stock bets by linking limits on new margin-funded purchases to a stock's free float, according to Reuters.

headline: IIRM board approves director designation change
summary: IIRM Holdings India Ltd board approved changing Hithendra Karadathodi Ramachandran's designation to Nominee Director and revising preferential issue fund allocation timelines.

headline: Carysil CFO resigns over relocation issue
summary: Anand H. Sharma resigned as Executive Director and Group CFO of Carysil Ltd, citing inability to relocate to Bhavnagar HQ under new growth strategy.

headline: Thangamayil seeks shareholder nod for new directors
summary: Thangamayil Jewellery Limited has issued a postal ballot notice seeking member approval for the appointment of K. Thiagarajan as Independent Director and B. Rajesh Kanna as Whole-time Director & CFO.

headline: Tata Chemicals denies knowledge of IPO negotiations
summary: Tata Chemicals responded to a BSE inquiry regarding IPO news, stating it has no knowledge of any negotiations or undisclosed details, and denied the accuracy of the news article in question.

headline: Gillette India shifts grooming ops to Bhiwadi
summary: Gillette India approves consolidation of grooming manufacturing from Baddi to Bhiwadi. The move involves ₹60 crore capex and a one-time expense of ₹100 crore.

headline: Allcargo Terminals shareholders ratify RPT
summary: Shareholders of Allcargo Terminals approved corrective measures to ratify a material related party transaction with Allcargo Logistics for FY25, with 99.96% votes in favour.

headline: Le Lavoir resubmits Q2FY27 results after filing error
summary: Le Lavoir Limited resubmitted its Q2FY27 consolidated results to BSE after attaching the wrong review report. The company reported a consolidated net loss of ₹59.64 lakh for the quarter.

headline: SEL Manufacturing loses chairperson, two directors
summary: SEL Manufacturing Company Limited reported the resignation of Chairperson Meghna Anup Gala and two other directors citing personal commitments.

headline: Nyssa Corp seeks shareholder nod to divest Vasistha Developers stake
summary: Nyssa Corporation Limited has initiated a postal ballot process seeking member approval to divest its entire investment in M/s. Om Vasistha Developers, aiming to improve liquidity and reduce debt.

headline: Fractal Industries H1FY27 PAT up 6.11% to ₹711 lakh
summary: Fractal Industries reported a 6.11% YoY rise in net profit for H1FY27, driven by margin expansion despite a slight dip in revenue. The company also announced plans for a Dubai subsidiary and a new B2C brand.

headline: Angel One MTF revenue at 20% of total income in Q2FY27
summary: Angel One's margin trade funding revenue accounted for 20% of its total income in Q2FY27, highlighting the growing contribution of MTF to the broking firm's earnings.

headline: Anand Rathi MTF revenue at 18.2% of total income in Q2FY27
summary: Anand Rathi's margin trade funding revenue accounted for 18.2% of total income in Q2FY27, highlighting the segment's contribution to the firm's overall earnings mix.

headline: Bosch Home Comfort seeks approval for ₹400 crore RPTs
summary: Bosch Home Comfort India Limited has issued a postal ballot notice seeking shareholder approval for material related party transactions worth up to ₹400 crore with Highly Electrical Appliances India Pvt. Ltd. The voting period runs from November 19 to December 18, 2026.

headline: Arihant Superstructures seeks shareholder nod for new independent director
summary: Arihant Superstructures Limited has issued a postal ballot notice to regularize the appointment of Pradeep Mehta as Non-Executive Independent Director. Voting opens November 23, 2026.

headline: Hyundai Motor India shares flag large trade on BSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 300,000 shares of Hyundai Motor India on BSE at ₹2129.00 per share, with a combined value of ₹63.87 crore.

headline: eClerx seeks approval to raise MD remuneration cap
summary: eClerx Services Limited has issued a postal ballot notice seeking shareholder approval to increase the managerial remuneration limit for MD Kapil Jain from 5% to 18% of net profits.

headline: Equitas SFB to attend Kotak Midcap Conference
summary: Equitas Small Finance Bank will participate in the Kotak Midcap Conference 2026 on November 27, 2026, in Mumbai. The bank will hold group and one-to-one meetings.

headline: Jyothy Labs to meet Locus Investment Group on Nov 18
summary: Jyothy Labs Limited will hold a one-on-one investor meeting with Locus Investment Group on November 18, 2026. No unpublished price sensitive information will be shared.

headline: Narayana Health to host investor meetings Nov 18-19
summary: Narayana Hrudayalaya Limited will hold one-to-one physical meetings with institutional investors on November 18 and 19, 2026. The sessions include discussions with IMCO and Wasatch Global Advisors.

headline: Torrent Power schedules analyst meetings in late Nov
summary: Torrent Power Ltd announced meetings with 4D Infrastructure on Nov 25 and Kotak's Midcap Conference on Nov 27. Both events are in-person.

headline: Indo SMC shares audio link of Nov 16 investor meet
summary: Indo SMC Limited filed an intimation with BSE regarding the audio recording of its investor meet held on November 16, 2026. The transcript will be uploaded later.

headline: Laser Power & Infra seeks shareholder nod for CMD re-appointment
summary: Laser Power & Infra Limited has issued a postal ballot notice for the re-appointment of Deepak Goel as Chairman and Managing Director for a five-year term starting January 2027.

headline: Technocraft targets 20% revenue growth for FY27
summary: Technocraft Ventures expects 20% revenue growth for FY27, though a strong rupee may weigh on profitability. The company flagged currency headwinds as a key risk to margins.

headline: JPL block trade: ~4,60,376 shares at ₹1,396.10
summary: A block trade of ~4,60,376 shares of JPL was executed on the NSE at ₹1,396.10 per share, amounting to ₹64.27 crore in total transaction value.
